visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Intro phase: The female host stands on a Lukang street in a grey tank top and white undershirt, gesturing excitedly with her hands while blinking rapidly. The background is a grey storefront with a closed metal shutter. (2) First food spot: Close-up of a food stall branded '彥仲麵茶'. A person uses a black scoop to layer fine brown powder onto white shaved ice. The final dish is shown with white puffed rice and almond flakes. The host is seen eating the dessert with a white plastic spoon, showing a satisfied expression. (3) Second food spot: The scene shifts to an outdoor table with two elderly people (an older man in a green t-shirt and an older woman in a cycling jersey). A bowl of powder ice with amber-colored jelly cubes and dark brown syrup is shown in extreme close-up. The host pulls the elastic jelly with her spoon. (4) Third food spot: The host enters an indoor seafood restaurant with orange signage. Plates of fried 'shrimp monkeys' with white onions and crispy green leaves are displayed. Close-ups show oysters on rice topped with scallions and sauce. The host eats with a pink bowl and gives a thumbs-up. (5) Fourth food spot: Outside a red-tabled stall branded '王罔麵線糊'. A red bowl of viscous noodle soup with green onions is shown. The host eats a spoonful and reacts with wide-open eyes. (6) Fifth food spot: The host holds a pink plastic bag with '老龍師' branding. Inside a car, she takes a large bite of a white steamed bun, revealing a juicy pinkish meat filling. (7) Outro: Shots of a traditional temple interior with a deity statue and a narrow brick alleyway. The host is seen from the back wearing a blue sun hat and denim shorts, walking through a scenic alley.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy female narration accompanied by an upbeat, major-key synth-pop BGM. The speech rate is fast and the tone is highly enthusiastic. (2) At 0:02, a 'whoosh' SFX marks a rapid visual transition. (3) By 0:11, a male voice is heard briefly in a conversational, lower-pitch tone. (4) 0:18 features exaggerated slurping and eating sounds (foley) layered over the narration as the host eats shaved ice. (5) Throughout the middle section, 'ding' and 'pop' UI sound effects trigger whenever prices or shop ratings appear on screen. (6) Ambient restaurant chatter and the clinking of spoons against plastic are audible but kept low in the mix. (7) 1:07 shows a slight change in reverb as the recording environment shifts to a car interior, with the female host's voice sounding more proximal. (8) The video ends with a musical riser and a final high-pitched greeting from the host.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Introduction of 5 spots -> Closing/CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To provide a highly energetic and informative guide to top-rated local snacks in Lukang, Changhua, using Google ratings as a credible filter to attract food-loving tourists.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Detailed display of restaurant names, addresses, and Google ratings along with positive tasting reviews.

high_inference.freeDescribe: A classic example of Taiwanese 'Short Video' food vlogging, characterized by extremely high text density, fast editing cuts, and consistent upbeat BGM to maintain viewer retention.
